label: Hold
notes: spec 2026-10-07-enemy-ai-and-battle §4.4: first draft. A standing order set by courier. defence_permille scales the side's defence (1000 = none); morale_decay_permille scales a day's morale loss (1000 = none); retreat_odds_permille = the odds below which the regiment retreats on its own (0 = never); retreats_on_contact 1 = leaves on the first day of contact

label: Steady
notes: no change; retreats of its own accord when the odds fall below 300 per mille

label: Evade
notes: weaker in defence; leaves the field on the first day of contact
